acceptance: `python -c 'import theseus_reviewer.retry'` and `python -c 'import theseus_reviewer.selection'` both succeed from a clean interpreter.
`pytest tests/unit/reviewer/test_retry.py` and `pytest tests/unit/reviewer/test_selection.py` each pass when run alone.
A test imports each theseus_reviewer module in a fresh subprocess and fails on any ImportError.
Full suite green; merged under the Theseus review rule.
description:
Problem: on Theseus main (139930e, and PR #108), collecting tests/unit/reviewer/test_retry.py or test_selection.py on its own fails with `ImportError: cannot import name 'PoolBlock' from partially initialized module 'theseus_reviewer.selection'`. The cycle is retry -> selection -> capacity -> promotion -> github -> retry. The full suite passes only because another module imports first. A production entry point that imports retry or selection first would fail the same way.

Decision gate: confirm the cycle with `uv run -- python -c 'import theseus_reviewer.retry'` and `... selection` on current main before changing code; if neither fails from a clean interpreter, record the exact import order that does fail.

Guardrails: break the cycle by moving the shared type or deferring one import at its use site; do not change behaviour, public names or persisted state formats; no lazy-import shims kept for compatibility.
